semantics.exact_statement: For fixed finite-dimensional Gaussian Y with known real PSD C, r=HY is Gaussian on H mu+Im(V), V=H C H^T. At a candidate true mean, z in Im(V) has z^T V^+ z distributed chi-square(rank V); rank zero is a deterministic equality. Outside support the candidate is impossible regardless of the pseudoinverse score. Positive-eigenspace whitening is a proof step, not an assumption that the score already has the target law.

symbol_type_domain_map.Y_j: real d_j vector, d_j positive finite
symbol_type_domain_map.C: real symmetric PSD full joint covariance, may be singular
symbol_type_domain_map.K_j: fixed real d_(j+1) by d_j matrix
symbol_type_domain_map.H: block differences; H_j has -K_j and I

frame_signature_units_conventions.metric: Euclidean finite dimensional; compatible feature units; no physical spacetime claim

assumptions: Finite depth and compatible block sizes; fixed transports and specified full law; singular PSD permitted.
D1 needs only finite second moments. D2/D4 require joint Gaussianity. D3 is deterministic before applying to a law.
positivity_nonzero_conditions: C positive semidefinite, not necessarily definite
exclusions: fitted/adaptive law without a separate sampling model
observational coverage or FORMAL_DEPTH promotion from partial checks
singular_loci: kernel C; kernel V; deterministic support

target.equivalence_relation: Exact identities/proof of the full declared proposition over the stated domain, not equality on examples.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not assume the target identity in an intermediate rewrite.
Do not import sibling solver results before adjudication.
